subject: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)
content:
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

Hi Samir / Priya / marketplace ops team —

Thanks again for agreeing to the joint showcase. We have a customer-facing demo that needs a three-way stitching across: Redwood hosted runtime (US-West), Stratus Systems SI integration (customer pre-install), and CloudBridge managed GKE artifacts. The original slot on May 6 is now constrained on the Stratus side because their lead engineer is on client travel.

Can we please rebalance and lock a new slot that satisfies all parties? Proposed windows (PDT):
- Option A: May 11, 09:00–10:00 (tight, preferred for AWS SI)
- Option B: May 11, 13:00–14:30 (longer, allows rehearsal)
- Option C: May 12, 07:30–09:00 (early APAC-friendly handoff)

I attached the runbook and the latest agenda (agenda-stitch-v2). Quick asks:
- Samir: confirm Stratus lead availability for any of the above.
- Priya: confirm CloudBridge can prepare the GKE demo cluster snapshot for the chosen slot.
- Marketplace ops: any constraints for listing/recording during the slot?

If we can pick one by EOD Tuesday (May 4), I'll send calendar invites + dry-run slot.

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---

From: Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

Neha — thanks for the note. We want to participate but our SI lead (Amit) is booked May 11 morning through a client go-live. Option C is promising but our APAC engineer who owns the pre-install handoff is on a PTO day May 12 morning.

Can we consider:
- Option D: May 11, 16:00–17:30 PDT (late afternoon US, early evening EU) — gives us time to prep after the go-live and still overlap with Redwood and CloudBridge.

If we have to keep May 11 earlier, we can rotate responsibilities: Stratus can own the middle platform validation while Redwood owns the live generation and CloudBridge handles cluster verification. But that requires a short dry-run.

Samir
Sr. Solutions Architect | Stratus Systems
samir.desai@stratus-systems.com

---

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

Thanks Samir — Option D (May 11, 16:00–17:30 PDT) works for Redwood and should still be within marketplace recording hours. Vanessa / Karthik — can you cover the facilitation flow if Stratus needs to own the middle validation step? I can run the live generation portion and Priya can confirm cluster state.

I've attached a pared-down run order in the runbook (triple-stitch-demo-runbook.pdf) that marks primary/secondary responsibilities. Quick notes:
- 0:00–0:05 — intros (Marissa to own intros + SLAs)
- 0:05–0:20 — Stratus pre-install verification (Samir primary)
- 0:20–0:40 — Redwood live generation (Neha primary; Ben backup)
- 0:40–0:55 — CloudBridge validation & teardown (Priya primary)
- 0:55–1:30 — Q&A + next steps (all)

If we confirm today, I'll send invites and propose a 30-min dry-run on May 10 (UTC-friendly timing options below).

Calendar link to tentative slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-demo-stitch

Best,
Neha

---

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

Neha / team — thanks for pulling options together. I can take Marissa's intro slot if she has a conflict with the customer briefing on May 11 afternoon. Two small asks:
1) If we push to 16:00 PDT, our customer success lead (on the renewal path) asked to join for the last 15 minutes. That's ok, but please keep the Q&A time flexible.
2) Can we lock the dry-run at May 10, 09:00–09:30 PDT? That suits APAC for Priya as well.

If we lock Option D today I can update the customer calendar and include the CS lead.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

Neha / Samir — Option D (May 11, 16:00–17:30 PDT) is fine for CloudBridge. We confirm we can snapshot the GKE cluster and provide the verification script. We also strongly prefer the May 10 dry-run at 09:00 PDT so our dev lead can attend before EOD.

Two notes from our side:
- Please record the demo (for internal enablement) and share the recording with CloudBridge.
- We will send a short checklist (5 bullets) that we need validated before go-live — will attach separately.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Integrations | CloudBridge
priya@cloudbridge.io

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Samir Desai <samir.desai@stratus-systems.com>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudbridge.io>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com

Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triple-stitch demo slot rebalance (AWS SI + GCP partner)

All — locking in Option D: May 11, 16:00–17:30 PDT. Dry-run confirmed: May 10, 09:00–09:30 PDT. Actions: 
- Neha: send calendar invites + recording permission to marketplace ops.
- Samir: confirm Amit or alternate will attend live validation.
- Priya: share the 5-bullet checklist and the cluster snapshot link.
- Vanessa: include CS lead on the invite for the Q&A block.
- Marissa / Ben: stand by as backups for intros / live gen.

I'll create the calendar invites after Neha posts the final runbook updates (do that and tag me).

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
